svg.text: AI SOLUTION ARCHITECT · 2026-11-18 ROUND 249 · MULTIMODAL DOCUMENT PARSING & OCR SECURITY FAQ
Document Parsing & OCR Security Selection: Document Intelligence vs. Vision LLM vs. Unstructured + CDR
Defeating PDF /ToUnicode CMap Remapping, 0.1pt White-on-White Text & Excel xlSheetVeryHidden Injections in RAG & AP Workflows
526 Scenarios · 1,118 Assertions · 512 Vectors
BRK-507 & BRK-508 · Pixel CDR + Capability Broker
1. Enterprise Document Parsing & RAG Ingestion Architecture Comparison
🔵 Azure Document Intelligence
Prebuilt Invoice/Layout + Pixel-Level CDR
• Defense: Flatten PDF to bitmap before OCR
• Geometry: Bounding boxes drop <4pt micro-text
• Strength: Best-in-class multi-page table KVP
Architect Verdict:
Gold standard for AP invoices & procurement;
physically destroys hidden PDF text streams!
🟣 GPT-4o Vision / Phi-4 Direct
Multimodal Bitmap Read + Spotlighting
• Strength: Immune to raw /ToUnicode stream tricks
• Fit: Complex charts & handwritten notes
• Gap: Still reads visible prompt injections
Architect Verdict:
Great for visual diagrams; always wrap output
in Spotlighting tags and gate tool execution.
🟠 Open-Source (Docling / PyMuPDF)
Unstructured / openpyxl in ACA Sandbox
• Pitfall 1: Fast mode extracts poisoned PDF streams
• Pitfall 2: openpyxl loads xlSheetVeryHidden tabs
• Hardening: Force OCR & drop non-visible sheets
Architect Verdict:
Isolate open-source parsers in zero-egress
containers and purge customXml metadata!
🛡️ Pixel CDR + Capability Broker
Containing Visible-Text & Invoice Fraud
• G1 (Ingress): Pixel CDR + OpenXML tab scrubber
• G2 (Shields): Prompt Shields (Documents) scan
• G3 (Broker): 0.0248ms gate on awards & AP wires
Production Reference Verdict:
Even if an injection is printed in visible 12pt
font, Capability Broker blocks tool abuse!
2. Red-vs-Blue Trace: PDF /ToUnicode & Excel veryHidden Injection vs. Pixel CDR + Capability Broker
❌ Vulnerable Baseline: Raw Stream Extraction + No Broker (BRK-507 / BRK-508 Breach)
1. Bid-Package Hidden Injection (BRK-507): Vendor PDF (/ToUnicode) & Excel (xlSheetVeryHidden)
coerce bid-review Agent to read restricted-budget, alter award business-result & leak reserve.
2. Invoice OCR Match Bypass (BRK-508): PDF invoice margin micro-text coerces AP Agent to
waive three-way matching in trust-registry and wire $4,850 automatically!
💥 Root Cause: Parsers extract hidden streams humans never see & sessions hold write/pay rights!
✅ Hardened Document Pipeline: Pixel CDR + Document Intelligence + Broker (0.0% Breach)
• Gate 1 (Pixel CDR + OpenXML Scrub): Rasterizes PDFs & drops xlSheetVeryHidden worksheets
• Gate 2 (record-owner & restricted-data-boundary): Blocks bid-reserve reads & vendor egress
• Gate 3 (untrusted-write & fixed-business-output): Locks bid awards & three-way match rules
• Gate 4 (original-requester-payment): Blocks invoice-induced $4,850 AP wire in 0.0248 ms
🛡️ Measured Overhead: In-Memory Broker P50 = 0.0248 ms / SQLite WAL Receipt P50 = 7.21 ms
🛠️ Enterprise Document Parsing & OCR Pipeline Production Readiness Checklist
☑️ 1. Enforce Pixel CDR on External PDFs: Flatten pages to bitmaps before OCR to destroy /ToUnicode & hidden streams
☑️ 2. Scrub Office Hidden Compartments: Drop Excel hidden/veryHidden tabs, hidden rows/cols, vanish & customXml
☑️ 3. Filter Micro-Text via Bounding Boxes: Discard OCR text spans with height <4pt or ultra-low contrast
☑️ 4. Isolate Parsers in Zero-Egress ACA Sandboxes ☑️ 5. Run Prompt Shields (Documents) ☑️ 6. Gate via Capability Broker
